subject.title: fix: deliver completed replies when post-turn compaction fails

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this broader pre-compaction durability and successor-ownership fix, or the narrower compaction-error catch in the competing PR?
rationale: Both candidates address ordinary compaction failure, but only this PR adds restart-window durability and additional persisted session-ownership behavior; choosing the permanent lifecycle contract requires the owners of restart recovery and native compaction.

options.title: Adopt comprehensive durability
options.body: Rebase this PR and land it after confirming the exact-session persistence, restart recovery, and cleanup semantics.

options.title: Adopt narrower soft-fail
options.body: Land the competing PR and separately track the restart window if maintainers want to avoid expanding pending-delivery ownership in this fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt comprehensive durability
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR and land it after confirming the exact-session persistence, restart recovery, and cleanup semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties both replay-safe restart recovery and native Codex compaction ownership to this person.
